analysis: The only changed file is docs/architecture/inference.md. Head changes are a documentation addition (about lines 1742-1868), a new "Native Flint" section. The patch excerpt is truncated at the `EngineV...` fragment, so the remainder of the section is not visible. The base unit starts at line 1622, and the head unit shows lines 1-415 plus the patch excerpt. The visible patch text describes Flint model loading and prefill: the FlintModel.cbv2Prefill path, a strict loader that rejects missing, extra or duplicate tensors, and native BF16 KV. It makes no security-relevant claim, so no code, configuration or control changes. It does not touch the prefix-cache (T-041), SSD tier, attestation, key custody, or coordinator-to-provider contracts (TB-002, TB-007, TB-011). It does not alter TTL, scope, kill-switch or encryption semantics. The strict loader rejection of unsupported tensors and geometry is consistent with fail-closed behavior and with T-012/T-027 weight-integrity concerns, though it does not add weight-hash verification. Remaining uncertainty: the truncated rest of the Flint section could contain claims about prefix-cache, KV precision or model qualification that were not visible. Also, whether the Flint model type is gated by EngineV2SupportedModels.isSupported (invariant 1) is not shown in the supplied text. Neither is a finding, since it is outside the visible evidence and is documentation only.
